px-5 py-2 text-xs"><div>0.0<!-- -->s</div></div></div></div><h2 id="built-for-the-messiness-of-the-real-world"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#built-for-the-messiness-of-the-real-world">Built for the messiness of the real world</a></h2><p>We built <code>grok-voice-think-fast-1.0</code> through tight collaboration with partners like Starlink to combine top-tier intelligence with low response latency and organic conversational ability.</p><p>Our model prioritizes snappy responses and unparalleled cost effectiveness without compromising on accuracy or tool orchestration. The result is a model that lets teams confidently deploy complex, multi-turn voice experiences across almost any conceivable use case: Customer support, phone sales, appointment booking, restaurant reservations, and more.</p><p>This new model takes the top spot on the <span class="font-[system-ui,_-apple-system,_sans-serif]">τ</span>-voice Bench leaderboard, which evaluates full-duplex voice agents under realistic conditions including noise, accents, interruptions, and turn-taking. <a href="https://taubench.com/#leaderboard?benchmark=voice" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">See the benchmark details here</a>.</p><div class="not-prose mt-12 lg:-mx-16"><div class="bg-card relative flex min-w-0 shrink-0 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl"><div class="bg-card flex items-start real-world conditions: telephony audio, background noise, heavy accents, and frequent interruptions. It natively supports 25+ languages, making it ideal for global deployments.</p><h2 id="precise-data-entry-and-read-back"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#precise-data-entry-and-read-back">Precise data entry and read-back</a></h2><p>Collecting and confirming user information is critical for many workflows. Grok Voice is able to seamlessly collect email addresses, physical street addresses, phone numbers, full names, account numbers, and other structured data—even when information is spoken quickly or with a strong accent. It gracefully handles speech disfluencies and accepts natural corrections as a human would.</p><div class="not-prose my-12 leading-normal lg:-mx-12"><div class="bg-card relative flex h-[560px] w-full stroke-linecap="square"></path></svg></button></div></div></div></div></div><h2 id="real-time-reasoning-with-zero-added-latency"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#real-time-reasoning-with-zero-added-latency">Real-time reasoning with zero added latency</a></h2><p>Grok Voice Think Fast performs reasoning in the background, allowing it to think through challenging queries and workflows in real-time with no impact on response latency. This enables intelligent answers while retaining the dexterity needed for natural conversation.</p><h2 id="harder-to-fool"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#harder-to-fool">Harder to fool</a></h2><p>Voice models often default to confident, plausible-sounding answers, despite being completely wrong. We&#x27;ve built <code>grok-voice-think-fast-1.0</code> to reason through edge cases before responding, catching obvious mistakes that other models get wrong.</p><div class="not-prose bg-card my-12 rounded-2xl p-6"><div class="mb-6 flex flex-col gap-1.5"><p class="text-primary/60 text-sm font-medium">Prompt</p><p class="text-primary text-base">Which months of the year are spelled with the letter X?</p></div><div class="grid gap-3 lg:grid-cols-2"><div class="bg-background flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl p-5"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><div class="text-primary text-base font-medium">grok-voice-think-fast-1.0</div><div class="flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-success/10 text-success" aria-label="Correct answer"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" data-slot="icon" class="stroke-[2] size-4"><path d="M19.7998 6.59961L10.1221 19.5039L4.30762 13.9219L5.69238 12.4785L9.87793 16.4961L18.2002 5.40039L19.7998 6.59961Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div></div><p class="text-primary text-sm leading-6">None of the months are spelled with the letter X. You can check them all, but X doesn&#x27;t appear in any month name.</p></div><div class="bg-background flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl p-5"><div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><div class="text-primary text-base font-medium">Other Models</div><div class="flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-error/10 text-error" aria-label="Incorrect answer"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" data-slot="icon" class="stroke-[2] size-4"><path d="M6 6L18 18M18 6L6 18" stroke="currentColor"></path></svg></div></div><p class="text-primary text-sm leading-6">Only one month is spelled with the letter X. It&#x27;s February.</p></div></div></div><h2 id="powering-customer-support-and-sales-for-starlink"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#powering-customer-support-and-sales-for-starlink">Powering customer support and sales for Starlink</a></h2><p>Grok Voice enables Starlink&#x27;s phone sales and customer support experience at <a href="tel:+18884678275">+1 (888) GO STARLINK</a>. This requires working across numerous languages, helping customers through customer support scenarios, and onboarding new customers via sales:</p><ul>
<li><strong>20% conversion rate.</strong> In 1 out of every 5 of sales inquiries, the customer purchases Starlink service while on the phone with Grok.</li>
<li><strong>70% resolution rate.</strong> The majority of customer support inquiries are resolved autonomously by the Grok Voice agent with no human in the loop.</li>
<li><strong>28 tools.</strong> This single agent uses dozens of distinct tools across hundreds of support and sales workflows.</li>
<li><strong>Accuracy is critical.</strong> Grok handles high-stakes decisions; the model autonomously performs hardware troubleshooting workflows, issues hardware replacements, and grants service credits.</li>
</ul><div class="not-prose my-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 sm:flex-row"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="bg-card hover:bg-card-hover flex items-center rounded-2xl
